items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...David Jones, he was quite young... I know nothing about him. ... You all didn't get in touch with David Jones in California. No, we missed him. INTERVIEWEE: We tried to find him.

ctx.x: And you couldn't find Wade Willie, you say? No.
I'm afraid Wade is dead maybe, but Jones is still out there. I know, Ed.
He was there when I was there. He was doing... He was a maintainer's man in some place. He moved...
